name: Wanderlog Pro
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Wanderlog Pro, build a collaborative itinerary from user-entered places, notes, and reservations. The hard boundary is maps, travel data, collaboration, offline access, route optimization, and mobile apps, plus proprietary live data and network coverage.
